attributes.text: Display duration of weather data in minutes

Here you choose how long you want to see weather information. A long Display duration only makes limited sense, because first the weather changes and secondly means more data and higher load and thus increase battery consumption.
The real-time location shows you your location in as current and accurate as possible

If automatic detection is enabled, your last position will always be stored in your smartphone. Storm-Alert leads itself from any active location in the background, which is often enough done by other apps. Storm-Alert just uses the last known position. It is fast and saves battery.
